signals.text: Revenue grew 4% a year over 3 years vs 10% over 5: growth is slowing.
Profit compounded at 3% vs revenue at 4%: profit is tracking sales.
Operating margin compressed 162 bps in 3 years (36.2% → 34.6%).
Working-capital days lengthened by 27 days in 3 years (20 → 47).
Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 79% of reported profit: some profit is stuck in working capital.
